clarity.notes: Vercel pure-white canvas + near-black text. Shadow-as-border hairline removes visual noise. Focus-visible rings added globally for keyboard navigation.

hierarchy.notes: Geist Sans display at 48px with -0.02em tracking. 4-tier foreground ramp clear. ALL CAPS letter-spacing now at 0.06em minimum.

typography.notes: 7-token syntax highlighting (kw/str/cm/fn/num/type/op) all derived from Vercel palette. Geist Mono for code blocks.

motion.notes: prefers-reduced-motion in all 7 files. Toast notifications with toastIn/toastOut keyframe animation. CSS transitions at 150-200ms.

brand.notes: Pure white #ffffff canvas, Vercel Black #171717 text. Console Blue #0070f3 accent. Black primary CTAs. Toast uses inverted fg/bg.

accessibility.notes: All outline:none replaced. :focus-visible globally. prefers-reduced-motion present. Toast replaces alert() — no intrusive dialogs. Form labels wired. aria-labels on icon buttons.

interaction.notes: Markdown toolbar with 7 insert actions + word count. Toast feedback with auto-dismiss + dynamic comment insertion. Button press animation (translateY). Tab switching in archive + admin views.
